title.zh: 将巴伦苏埃拉市 Canumay 描笼涯的 Valenzuela 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Canumay East 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Valenzuela National High School - Canumay East Annex in Barangay Canumay, City of Valenzuela, Metro Manila From the Valenzuela National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Canumay East National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Valenzuela National High School - Canumay East Annex in Barangay Canumay, City of Valenzuela, Metro Manila From the Valenzuela National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Canumay East National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Canumay East của Trường Trung học Valenzuela Quốc gia tại Barangay Canumay, Thành phố Valenzuela, Vùng Metro Manila khỏi Trường Trung học Valenzuela Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Canumay East Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Canumay East ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Valenzuela แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Canumay เมือง Valenzuela เขตมหานครมะนิลาออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Valenzuela แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Canumay East แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Canumay East, Sekolah Menengah Valenzuela Nasional di Barangay Canumay, Kota Valenzuela, Wilayah Metropolitan Manila dari Sekolah Menengah Valenzuela Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Canumay East Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Canumay East, Sekolah Menengah Valenzuela Kebangsaan di Barangay Canumay, Bandar Valenzuela, Wilayah Metropolitan Manila daripada Sekolah Menengah Valenzuela Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Canumay East Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Valenzuela National High School – Canumay East Annex in Barangay Canumay, City of Valenzuela, Metro Manila is hereby separated from the Valenzuela National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Canumay East National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Valenzuela National High School – Canumay East Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Canumay East National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Canumay East National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Valenzuela National High School – Canumay East Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
